title: Crispy Pistachio Kunafa Cheese Roll
hookLine: Golden buttered kataifi rolled around stretchy mozzarella & drenched in blossom syrup.

steps.title: Preheat Air Fryer & Measure Ingredients
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat your air fryer to 330°F (165°C) for 3 minutes and line the basket with perforated parchment or a light oil mist. Measure out {kataifi_k}, {ghee_k}, and {mozz_k} in a mixing bowl so they combine evenly.

steps.title: Wrap Stretchy Cheese in Kataifi
steps.instructionTemplate: Toss {kataifi_k} with {ghee_k}, lay flat strips, place sticks of {mozz_k} inside, and roll tightly into golden cylinders. Keep {kataifi_k}, {ghee_k}, and {mozz_k} prepped and measured within reach so each step comes together smoothly and evenly.

steps.title: Bake Until Amber & Pour Syrup
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake or air-fry at 390°F (200°C) for 18 minutes until crackling amber. Immediately pour cool {syrup_k} over hot rolls and scatter {pist_k}.
steps.criticalTip: Hot kunafa + cool syrup is the golden rule so the pastry stays glass-crisp!
steps.creatorSecret: Measure aromatics and syrups before heating so timing stays crisp and your glaze hits glossy perfection.

steps.title: Rest 5 Minutes & Serve Warm
steps.instructionTemplate: Carefully lift Crispy Pistachio Kunafa Cheese Roll out of the air-fryer basket and rest 5 minutes on a cooling rack so the crust crisps up. Plate into 6 servings and enjoy warm.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 28 mins.
